answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one tundra weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. The inlet report exposes the merge explicitly at each walnut. Because of that, an adversary who spins up 194 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 66 times the capital for one share. A farm of 3572 identities would post 3356 proofs and burn roughly 74 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
